analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: We may share limited categories of personal data (online identifiers and product-related information used to display appropriate ads) with these third parties for cross-contextual advertising purposes, as defined under California and other applicable U.S. state laws.

analysis.headline: Shares with Group Companies
analysis.quote: We only disclose your Personal Data as described below, within our group of companies, with our partners, with service providers that process data on our behalf and with public authorities, when required by applicable law.

analysis.headline: Cross-Border Data Transfers
analysis.quote: We are a global business that provides products and services all around the world. In order to reach all of our users and provide all of them with our software, we operate on an infrastructure that spans the globe.

analysis.headline: Records Your Support Calls
analysis.quote: To record our phone conversation when you contact our tech support by phone to better respond to your requests.

analysis.headline: Collects Device & Product Data
analysis.quote: Product Data includes two sub-categories: Device Data includes information about the operating system; hardware; city/country location of device; IP address, device error logs; browser; network; applications running on the device, including the Avast products; and Service Data includes information about product usage and events relating to use of our product by you.

analysis.headline: Uses Third-Party Analytics
analysis.quote: We use analytical tools, including third-party analytical tools, which allow us, among other things, to identify potential performance or security issues with our products, to improve their stability and function, to understand how you use our products, and websites so that we can optimize and improve your user experience, and to evaluate and improve our campaigns.

analysis.headline: Retains Product Data 6 Years
analysis.quote: The rolling deletion periods for Product Data are not longer than six years.

analysis.headline: No Discrimination for Rights
analysis.quote: Right to Equal Service - Right not to receive discriminatory treatment for the exercise of your privacy rights, subject to certain limitations.
